Seer.directive_rationale: avoid treating the Witch's hesitation as a 'textbook' wolf signal without first considering the stress of power-role claims
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Hoang immediately demanded all players reveal their roles and stated that any hesitation or refusal to claim is a sign of a wolf trying to hide.
Seer.verdict_notes: Hoang did not consider power role stress; instead, he explicitly defined hesitation as a wolf signal.

Seer.directive_rationale: Your aggression toward the Witch nearly cost the village its most versatile asset
Seer.verdict_notes: The Witch (Cong) did not hesitate; Cong claimed the role and aligned with the Seer quickly in both rounds.

Guard.directive_rationale: never waste a protect on a primary suspect
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard did not protect any primary suspects; he protected himself in Round 1 and the Seer in Round 2.

Guard.directive_rationale: Prioritize the Seer or suspected innocents
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard prioritized the Seer in Round 2.

Witch.directive_rationale: In future games, claim your role decisively
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Cong stated 'I am the Witch' and immediately began pushing for the exile of Meg.
Witch.verdict_notes: Cong claimed the role decisively during the first round debate.

Witch.directive_rationale: use your healing potion to save the Seer if they are targeted
Witch.verdict_notes: The Seer was not targeted by the wolves; Cong was targeted and saved himself.
Cong did not use the poison potion in either night phase.

Villager.directive_rationale: distrust emotional appeals (like 'mourning') used to stall for time
Villager.verdict_notes: No player used an emotional appeal to stall for time during the debates.

Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nam and Jin both immediately claimed 'Villager' and demanded that others reveal their roles to avoid stalling.
Villager.verdict_notes: Both villagers prioritized transparency by claiming their roles and demanding the same from others.

Villager.directive_rationale: In the bidding phase, bid high to ensure you can challenge suspicious narratives immediately
Villager.verdict_notes: There was no bidding phase in this game record.
